_compaction.scope: Sample arrays summarized by turn/edge/direction with all-sample extrema and first/last snapshots. Executed assertions/results remain in their unchanged files.

samples.method: All samples grouped by turn, edge and direction. Per-group counts and all-sample extrema are retained, with first/last compact snapshots. Original full samples remain archived. No test is rerun or newly claimed by this derivative.
